demo.title: groundtruth.sh
demo.code:
# What happened to this coin, and who made it? ($0.01, first 5 calls a day free)
bankr prompt "Using the groundtruth skill, pull the record for GCyzQVvCqHvE2pgAmKamDaZwL4rnT6QyuUG96fYYpump"

# The dev's track record ($0.01)
bankr prompt "Using the groundtruth skill, what is this creator's record: <wallet>"

# Before you ape
bankr prompt "Using the groundtruth skill, check this CA and show me the creator's rug count"

setup: No install required: two plain HTTP GET endpoints behind x402 v2 (USDC, $0.01 per call, Base or Solana)
/v1/record?ca= (coin) and /v1/flag?addr= (creator) serve 5 free calls per IP per day, then 402
Read-only. Never reports a coin as safe: GREEN is a record band, not a safety rating
